searchText: Hey <@654267572107083777> you may know this one, why did you guys in Nimbus not use OpenSSL QUIC implementation? I am looking for confirmation of something here isn't friendly to static linking We did try it first actually ended up choosing between BoringSSL and AWS-LC (more or less a BoringSSL fork; https://daniel.haxx.se/blog/2025/06/23/a-family-of-forks/). Other static linking-friendly QUIC-capable libraries were e.g., not license-compatible (e.g., WolfSSL) ahh thanks so much! this is helpful! Hey <@491624610215886849> I've been diagnosing Lighthouse downscoring my node at home and eventually banning. I got panda cli correlating logs from Lighthouse on devnet-8 with my own gossip log to find out the error message, and Claude found this line in Lighthouse with the downscore https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/stable/beacon_node/lighthouse_network/src/service/mod.rs#L1566-L1568. I've checked since with the lighthouse nodes and there are many peers that are being scored even worse than my node on the devnet, we aren't able to clear your messages fast enough. So whenever PK floods us with blobs we're being isolated. Not my field so calling the actual experts to verify this, but I am seeing on my local node that PTC attestations are the majority of the messages and processing time I need on the node. This was predictable being a global topic, but currently, 66% of the time my node spends in verifying gossip is on PTC attestations, this seems quite excessive and we should probably verify if these numbers are across nodes and do something about it if true.
